content.title: Explaining your backend experience
content.subtitle: Java interview · reliable services
content.description: Practise a concise introduction to your Java backend experience. Listen to the example, repeat it, then adapt it to your own project.

body.phrase: I build reliable backend services with Java and Spring Boot. I verify recovery paths and monitor production behaviour.
body.usage: Use this phrase when describing your responsibilities in a technical interview. Follow it with one concrete example and a measurable result.
body.example: I designed a retry mechanism that recovers safely from temporary failures.
I added health checks and alerts to make production issues easier to investigate.
In my last project, I reduced request latency by improving database queries.
